about: The Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo is a specialized municipality in northeastern Alberta, covering a vast boreal territory larger than many countries. Fort McMurray is the urban service area, not a separate city; hamlets such as Anzac, Janvier, and Fort Chipewyan sit far from that core. Oil-sands work camps and fly-in industry shape the regional economy along the Athabasca and Clearwater rivers. About 72,000 people live in Wood Buffalo.
seoSummary: Northeastern Alberta specialized municipality around Fort McMurray and the Athabasca oil sands.
